plan.title: Reject Auction Bid and Allow Rebid

steps.note: Create an auction event using the default auction stage.
Apply the auction pricing template before adding items.
Add a line item for the vendor to quote.
Commit a bidding schedule so the event can be published.
Invite one vendor whose bid will be rejected and resubmitted.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Have the invited vendor submit the initial bid.
Confirm the initial vendor bid was accepted.
Open the auction Responses tab where the vendor bid and overflow menu are shown.
Confirm the buyer sees exactly one direct vendor response before rejection.

args.goal: Open the three-dot menu next to the vendor's bid, select Reject Bid, enable the option allowing the seller to bid again, confirm the rejection, and stop only when the bid is removed from the comparison view and QCS.

steps.note: Perform and verify the rejection flow that has no dedicated catalog action.
Have the same vendor submit a new bid after rebidding was allowed.
Confirm the vendor was allowed to submit the replacement bid.
Confirm the replacement response is visible to the buyer.
Open the comparison QCS after the replacement bid.
Confirm the rebid is represented by one real vendor column in QCS.
